# Invedus

> > Invedus is an ISO-certified outsourcing firm specializing in remote hiring and virtual employee services from India, serving startups and businesses across finance, legal, development, and administrative functions.

With 10+ years of experience and 95%+ client satisfaction across 31 countries, Invedus provides offshore talent solutions including virtual assistants, tax preparers, finance experts, mobile app developers, and legal support professionals. The company focuses on helping businesses scale through cost-effective remote workforce solutions.
